checks.name: known-root-and-version-canary-matrix
checks.detail: Executable fake-storage cases cover every known learner-envelope root, typed capture provenance and context, FSRS state/learning-step bounds, conditional review/observation row layouts, nested invalid shapes, missing/old/typed/fractional/null versions, non-finite values, and non-record prototypes; every case preserves prior bytes, performs zero writes, and leaves live learner roots unpublished. Reserved JSON member names are covered separately as valid own-property data.

checks.name: post-setitem-ui-exception-canary
checks.detail: The fake DOM throws from alert/layout lookup after setItem returns; durable bytes and live candidate publication still succeed, and a later safe alert sync recovers.

checks.name: dynamic-sheet-description-lifecycle
checks.detail: Without render, the stable alert token is added to and removed from an open sheet aria-describedby value while unrelated tokens are preserved.

checks.name: reserved-name-round-trip
checks.detail: Executable write/reload cases cover __proto__, constructor, and prototype as list names plus top-level and nested unknown extras; own properties and bytes survive without changing Object.prototype.

checks.name: candidate-self-validation
checks.detail: An invalid serialized candidate is rejected before setItem, leaving prior durable bytes untouched; the static check requires validation before the durability boundary.

checks.name: sticky-grade-row-byte-preservation
checks.detail: The verifier compares the complete body.zen .grade-row rule with the exact authority blob.

checks.name: fresh-live-head-replay
checks.detail: The reviewed r4 capability had sole parent ac880; r5 was rebuilt fresh on the same authority, preserving the live host-chrome guard and sticky grade CSS before applying the narrow reserved-name repair.

checks.name: standalone-regeneration
checks.reason: The bounded donor intentionally does not regenerate the already-stale standalone artifact.
